    The dual multiplicative basis #

    A twisted multiplicative basis of A over P gives one of Aᵐᵒᵖ over Pᵒᵖ (RayQuiver.MulBasis.op). With hmin_op, every statement proved for P from a multiplicative basis and minimality holds for Pᵒᵖ as well: this is the "duality" of BO13a §2.2.
